name: Speckled Stoneware Mug
description:
Wheel-thrown stoneware mug with a speckled oatmeal glaze. Holds about 12 oz.

Dishwasher and microwave safe. Each mug is unique — glaze patterns vary.

name: Hand-Poured Soy Candle
description:
Small-batch soy wax candle in a reusable amber jar. Scent: cedar, fig and a little smoke.

Approx. 40 hours burn time.

name: Macramé Wall Hanging
description: Knotted from soft recycled cotton cord on a driftwood branch. About 45 cm wide.

name: Personalised Leather Keyring
description:
Vegetable-tanned leather, hand-stitched and stamped with up to 3 initials.

Add the initials you'd like in the order notes or reply to your confirmation email.

name: Watercolour Greeting Cards (set of 4)
description: Original botanical watercolours printed on textured recycled card, with kraft envelopes. Blank inside.

name: Chunky Knit Throw
description: Hand-knitted from merino wool. Roughly 100 × 130 cm — made to order in your choice of colour.
